title: Amplemarket Review (2026)
intro: Amplemarket is an AI multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo assistants. This review scores it with CRM methodology criteria — strong on automation/email, weaker on pipeline CRM depth.
summary: Amplemarket fits outbound teams that can fund a $600+/mo AI engagement suite. Keep a CRM for pipeline. Scores reflect first-party research, not hands-on testing.
verdict: Amplemarket is a strong AI outbound platform with a high price floor and weak CRM-pipeline fit. Review based on first-party research, not hands-on testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Product marketing emphasizes guided Duo assistants and unified inbox; still an advanced outbound suite rather than a simple CRM.
Amplemarket orchestrates outbound; deal pipelines stay in CRM systems like HubSpot/Salesforce.
Multichannel sequences, workflows, social automation, and AI copilots are core documented strengths.
Mailbox sync, Unibox, deliverability tooling, and AI copywriting are first-class.
Dedicated Analytics product for outbound performance monitoring.
Sequences/workflows/integrations are flexible; not an enterprise CRM customization canvas.
Salesforce/HubSpot plus Zapier/Clay/HTTP and mailbox providers are prominently documented.
Deliverability, domains, and seat/contact packaging imply meaningful RevOps overhead.
Growth/Elite raise contacts/seats with CSM; contact pools scale to 400k on Elite.
Startup at $600/mo annual is a high floor; Growth/Elite custom — strong only if unit economics of outbound justify it.

faq.question: How much does Amplemarket cost?
faq.answer: Official pricing lists Startup at $600/mo on an annual term. Growth and Elite are custom-quoted. All plans include a free trial.

faq.question: Is Amplemarket a CRM?
faq.answer: No. It is an AI outbound/engagement platform that integrates with CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot.

faq.question: Is this a hands-on SoftwareGlimpse lab review?
faq.answer: No. Approved from first-party Amplemarket research without recorded hands-on testing.

sections.heading: What Amplemarket is
sections.body: Amplemarket combines lead intelligence, AI assistants, multichannel sequences, deliverability, and analytics for outbound sales teams.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: Startup is the only publicly priced tier at $600/mo annual. Growth and Elite scale seats/contacts via custom quotes. Free trial is included across plans.

sections.heading: Core capabilities
sections.body: Documented pillars include Searcher/signals, Duo AI, multichannel engagement, Unibox, deliverability, analytics, and CRM/mailbox integrations.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for outbound-heavy teams with budget for an AI engagement suite. Poor fit as a cheap CRM substitute.

productExperience.summary: Outbound teams find leads via Searcher/signals, enrich data, run multichannel sequences, manage replies in Unibox, and coach performance in Analytics — with Duo AI assisting copy and prioritization.
